payload.name: Didit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect to your Didit workspace using your existing account, organization roles and permissions.

Create hosted verification links, find verification sessions and review their status, inspect and edit workflows and questionnaires, check case and report status, manage webhook destinations, and review aggregate verification analytics.

Customers complete identity checks on Didit's hosted verification page. Session and case results in ChatGPT contain operational references, statuses, dates and counts. Detailed identity evidence, images, private notes and report contents stay outside this plugin's responses.

The plugin does not offer standalone document or face uploads, government ID number inputs, one-time verification code inputs, raw API keys or payment checkout. Requested workspace information is shared with ChatGPT to answer your request. Only request records you are authorized to access and share. Review proposed changes before approving actions. An existing Didit account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过现有账户连接到您的Didit工作区，使用组织角色和权限进行访问。

创建托管验证链接，查找验证会话并查看其状态，检查和编辑工作流程及问卷调查，查看案件和报告状态，管理Webhook目标地址，并查看汇总验证分析数据。

客户在Didit的托管验证页面完成身份核验。ChatGPT中的会话和案件结果包含操作参考信息、状态、日期及统计数量。详细身份证据、图片、私有备注及报告内容不会包含在本插件的响应中。

payload.name: AutoQuote3D

payload.name: Zernio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Zernio connects ChatGPT to the social media accounts you have already linked in your Zernio workspace: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Snapchat, Discord and Slack.

Ask ChatGPT to schedule a post for a specific time, publish immediately, edit or cancel something that has not gone out yet, retry a failed post, or check a draft against each platform's rules (character limits, required media or title) before it is scheduled. Review what is scheduled, drafted, published or failed, and pull performance numbers: impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves and views for one post or across your accounts, plus the best times to post based on your own history.

Every action is limited to your own Zernio account. Publishing tools always ask for the exact accounts to use, and anything that goes live immediately is confirmed with you first. Sign in with your existing Zernio account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Zernio将ChatGPT与您在Zernio工作区中已链接的社交媒体账户连接：Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X、LinkedIn、Facebook、Threads、Pinterest、Reddit、Bluesky、Google商业资料、Telegram、Snapchat、Discord和Slack。

让ChatGPT为特定时间安排帖子，立即发布，编辑或取消尚未发出的内容，重试失败的帖子，或在发布前根据各平台规则（字符限制、必要媒体或标题）检查草稿。
查看已安排、草稿、已发布或失败的内容，获取性能数据：单个帖子或跨账户的曝光量、触达量、点赞、评论、分享、保存和观看次数，以及基于您历史记录的最佳发布时间。

所有操作均限于您的Zernio账户。
发布工具会始终要求指定具体的账户，任何立即上线的内容都会先征得您的确认。
使用现有Zernio账户登录即可开始。

payload.name: Jusratio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jusratio connects ChatGPT to Brazilian case law and legislation. Search 42+ million deduplicated decisions from 99 Brazilian courts and public authorities, alongside consolidated legislation structured article by article. Results are ranked by legal authority and linked to their original sources.

Use Jusratio to find relevant and binding precedents, validate legal arguments, identify contrary authorities, compare court positions, review legal documents, and draft well-grounded legal analyses, opinions, briefs, and other legal work with verifiable citations.

Create a free Jusratio account, no credit card required, to get started. Usage limits and available features depend on your plan.

payload.name: Trainual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trainual is where growing companies run the operating side of the business — how work should be done, and how it is actually going.

This plugin provides read access to your Trainual account so answers are grounded in your company’s own documented practice and current operating context rather than generic advice.

From the Training suite: search documented processes, policies, and role expectations. See what training has been assigned and who has completed it. Look up what a role is responsible for and which tools a team uses.

From the Operations suite: pull goals and progress against them, scorecard metrics and trends, meeting records and action items, and recurring team updates.

Together that means you can ask how something is supposed to work and how it is actually going in the same conversation — the connection Trainual is built around.

Common uses include onboarding support, answering "how do we do this here" without interrupting a colleague, preparing for a meeting or a one-on-one, checking training completion across a team, and drafting content that stays consistent with documented process.

Access follows Trainual’s existing permission model. Users only reach content their Trainual account already permits, and the plugin never modifies data.
payload.longDescription:
Trainual是成长型公司管理业务运营的场所——工作应如何开展以及实际推进情况如何。

该插件提供对Trainual账户的只读访问权限，确保回答基于您公司内部的文档化实践和当前运营背景，而非通用建议。

在培训模块中：搜索已记录的流程、政策和岗位期望。
查看已分配的培训内容及完成人员名单。
查阅岗位职责及团队使用的工具列表。

在运营模块中：查看目标及完成进度、评分卡指标与趋势、会议记录与行动项、以及定期团队更新内容。

这意味着您可以在同一场对话中同时询问『应该怎样运作』和『实际进展如何』——这正是Trainual的核心所在。

常见使用场景包括：提供入职支持、在不打扰同事的情况下解答『我们在这里是如何操作的』、为会议或一对一沟通做准备、检查团队培训完成情况，以及撰写与文档化流程保持一致的内容。

访问权限遵循Trainual现有的权限模型。
用户仅能查看其Trainual账户已授权的内容，插件从不修改任何数据。

payload.name: Signal Pulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Signal Pulse scans a business by name and website and reports whether AI assistants can find, describe, and recommend it accurately. It returns a Signal Strength rating (Strong, Weak, Low, or No Signal), a 0-100 score, a schema markup scan, and a per-platform summary of AI mentions. Built by Signal & Structure AI, an independent AI-discoverability consultancy, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. Free, one check per email, full report emailed to the requester.
payload.longDescription: Signal Pulse通过名称和网站扫描企业，并报告AI助手能否准确查找、描述并推荐该企业。它会返回信号强度评分（强、弱、低或无信号）、0-100分评分、结构化数据扫描结果以及各平台AI提及情况摘要。由独立AI可发现性咨询公司Signal & Structure AI开发，与OpenAI无关联也未获其认可。免费服务，每个邮箱仅限一次检测，完整报告将发送至请求者邮箱。

payload.name: Tesea

payload.name: AfterShip Post-Purchase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AfterShip Post-Purchase for ChatGPT makes shipment and returns operations as easy as having a conversation. Connect your AfterShip data and simply chat to search shipments, review delivery status and tracking timelines, spot exceptions, look up specific orders, or review return and RMA details including refund progress, shipping status, returned items, and outcomes. Then act on what you find: with your confirmation, ChatGPT can correct shipment records, re-track stalled shipment, mark a final delivery status, and move returns through approval, receiving, and resolution — always scoped to your organization and your own AfterShip role.
payload.longDescription: AfterShip Post-Purchase for ChatGPT让物流和退货操作变得像聊天一样简单。连接您的AfterShip数据后，只需通过对话即可搜索物流信息、查看配送状态和追踪时间线、发现异常情况、查询具体订单，或查看退货和RMA详情（包括退款进度、物流状态、退回商品及处理结果）。您可对发现的内容进行操作：在获得您的确认后，ChatGPT可更正物流记录、重新追踪停滞物流、标记最终配送状态，并推动退货流程完成审批、收货和问题解决——所有操作始终基于您的组织权限和AfterShip账号角色。

payload.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs

Get cited answers and playback rendered through the Jockey Interactive Language (JIL). Powered by TwelveLabs Marengo and Pegasus video understanding models.
payload.longDescription:
将您的照片和视频库连接至ChatGPT。
让Jockey帮您在全部照片和视频资料中查找任何人物、地点或时刻。
通过Jockey交互式语言（JIL）获取带引用的答案并进行回放。
由TwelveLabs Marengo和Pegasus视频理解模型提供支持。

payload.name: Qualyteam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Qualyteam quality-management workspace from ChatGPT. Find and analyze documents, nonconformities, risks, opportunities, tasks, and dashboards, and complete supported nonconformity workflow actions using your existing permissions.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT访问您的Qualyteam质量管理的工作空间。查找并分析文档、不符合项、风险、机会、任务和仪表板，使用现有权限完成受支持的不符合项工作流操作。

payload.name: Markty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Markty is an AI marketing team for small businesses: a manager and department experts for social media, SEO and blog, e-commerce and email, working from your brand's research, voice and strategy. Ask for what you would ask a colleague: today's marketing brief, three Instagram posts about a launch, a blog outline, an image for a weekend sale, a check on how visible your brand is in AI answers, or to schedule a post. Everything Markty creates is saved to your Markty account, and nothing is published until you approve it in the Markty calendar. Requires a paid Markty plan. Each request to the team costs one Markty credit; images and other paid actions cost the same credits as in the Markty app, and reading your brand data is free.
payload.longDescription: Markty是面向中小企业的AI营销团队，包含社交媒体、SEO和博客、电商和邮件营销的经理及部门专家，基于您的品牌调研、语气和策略开展工作。您可以像向同事提问一样提出需求：今天的营销简报、关于新品发布的三条Instagram帖子、博客大纲、周末促销图片、检查品牌在AI答案中的可见度，或安排帖子发布。Markty创建的所有内容都会保存至您的Markty账户，且需经您在Markty日历中审批后才会发布。需要付费的Markty计划。每次向团队发起请求会消耗一个Markty积分；图片及其他付费操作消耗的积分与Markty应用内相同，而阅读品牌数据为免费操作。

payload.name: InsightSignal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InsightSignal is a private, multi-source-verified knowledge graph for B2B company and contact intelligence. Every data point in a user's workspace is verified by two or more independent sources (AI analysis with live web grounding, professional-network data, web search, and email/phone validators), carries a numeric confidence score, and links to the citation page where the value was verified.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can query the user's own verified data: search and filter companies and people, read company profiles with A-F quality grades and operational status, pull contact details with email deliverability and phone validity scores, summarize multi-source research reports with verdicts and evidence links, explore business relationships in the knowledge graph (competitors, partners, subsidiaries, key people), compare companies side-by-side, and track how verified data changed over time through immutable snapshots.

Users can also trigger actions with explicit confirmation: verify a new company through the multi-source pipeline, generate or refresh research reports, enrich contacts, re-score companies against a stated business intent (sales prospecting, competitor analysis, partner fit, investment screening), and push verified records to their connected CRM.

All data is strictly scoped to the signed-in user's InsightSignal account and organization. The plugin never exposes other users' data, and paid actions always present a cost estimate and require confirmation before executing.
payload.longDescription:
InsightSignal 是一个私有的、多源验证的知识图谱，提供 B2B 公司和联系人情报。用户工作区中的每个数据点均通过两个或更多独立来源（AI 分析结合实时网络验证、专业网络数据、网络搜索以及邮件/电话验证器）进行验证，带有数值化置信度评分，并链接到原始引用页面。

通过此插件，ChatGPT 可查询用户自己的验证数据：搜索并筛选公司和人员，查看带有 A-F 质量等级和运营状态的公司档案，获取带有邮件可送达性评分和电话有效性评分的联系信息，总结多源研究报告并附带结论与证据链接，探索知识图谱中的商业关系（竞争对手、合作伙伴、子公司、关键人物），并排对比公司，通过不可变快照追踪验证数据随时间的变化。

用户还可通过明确确认触发操作：通过多源验证流程验证新公司，生成或更新研究报告，丰富联系人信息，根据指定的业务目标（销售拓展、竞品分析、合作伙伴匹配、投资筛选）重新评分公司，并将验证记录推送到已连接的 CRM 系统。

所有数据严格限定于登录用户的 InsightSignal 账户及组织。插件永远不会暴露其他用户的数据，付费操作始终会显示成本预估并在执行前需要确认。

payload.name: AIsa GTM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIsa GTM helps users discover research capabilities, inspect their inputs, obtain cost estimates, and run authorized market, customer, creator, prospect, and website research through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: AIsa GTM帮助用户发现研究功能，检查其输入内容，获取成本估算，并通过ChatGPT执行授权的市场、客户、创作者、潜在客户和网站研究。

payload.name: Radarkit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Radarkit tracks how AI assistants answer the questions your customers ask. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews the prompts you care about on a schedule, stores every answer, and tells you whether your brand was mentioned, where it ranked, how it was described, which competitors appeared instead, and which websites the answer relied on.

With this plugin you can ask ChatGPT about your Radarkit data in plain language:

- How visible is my brand in AI answers this month, by model and by day?
- Which competitors and which source websites show up most for my prompts?
- What is the sentiment of the answers that mention us?
- Did the models search the web, and what did they search for?
- Show me the answers that left us out, with the full answer text as Markdown.
- Add new prompts to track, group them into topics, or re-ask a prompt right now.
- Export every answer, source, ranking or competitor mention for a date range as a CSV file.

Sign in with your Radarkit account and choose what the plugin may do: read data, add prompts and create exports, or create content. Every call is listed on your API usage page with what it did and what it cost. You can disconnect at any time from Settings, API keys.

A Radarkit subscription is required. Reads spend API credits from your plan; data exports spend Export rows.
payload.longDescription:
Radarkit会跟踪AI助手如何回答您的客户提出的问题。它会定期向ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot、Google AI模式和Google AI概览提出您关注的提示内容，存储所有答案，并告知您品牌是否被提及、排名情况、描述方式、替代出现的竞争对手以及答案依赖的网站来源。

通过此插件，您可以使用自然语言向ChatGPT询问您的Radarkit数据：

- 我的品牌在AI答案中的可见度如何？按模型和日期统计
- 我的提示中出现最多的竞争对手和来源网站是哪些
- 提及我们的答案情感倾向如何
- 模型是否进行了网络搜索？搜索了哪些内容
- 展示遗漏我们的答案，包含完整的Markdown格式答案文本
- 添加新提示进行跟踪，将提示分组到主题中，或立即重新提问
- 将指定日期范围内的所有答案、来源、排名或竞争对手提及导出为CSV文件

使用您的Radarkit账户登录，并选择插件可执行的操作：读取数据、添加提示和创建导出，或生成内容。每次调用都会在您的API使用页面显示操作记录和消耗成本。您可随时通过设置-API密钥页面断开连接。

需要Radarkit订阅服务。数据读取会消耗API积分，数据导出会消耗导出行数。

payload.name: Chat Estelar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chat Estelar helps authorized Inmobo users review aggregate operational performance for a selected broker/builder, including listings, lead funnel, appointments, and active-agent metrics.
payload.longDescription: Chat Estelar帮助授权用户查看选定经纪人/开发商的整体运营绩效，包括房源信息、潜在客户流程、预约情况以及活跃代理指标。

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Search Console
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD.AI Google Search Console brings data from authorized Search Console properties into ChatGPT, helping site owners, marketers, and SEO teams understand how their sites appear in Google Search.

Use it to:

• Diagnose why a site or URL is not showing on Google by reviewing index status, crawl and fetch state, robots access, sitemaps, canonicals, and mobile usability.

• Explain indexing issues such as Crawled – currently not indexed, Discovered – currently not indexed, duplicate canonicals, noindex, blocked pages, soft 404s, redirects, and server errors.

• Check sitemap processing, errors, warnings, download dates, and URL counts.

• Analyze keywords and rankings using clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, date, or search appearance.

• Compare periods to find traffic gains and losses, CTR opportunities, ranking changes, and the queries driving each page.

• List connected properties and explore Search Console data conversationally through ChatGPT and MCP.

HYPD.AI is read-only. It cannot request indexing, submit sitemaps, add or verify properties, manage users, edit content, or change rankings. It analyzes connected properties, explains findings, and recommends next steps.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Google搜索控制台将已授权的搜索控制台数据导入ChatGPT，帮助网站所有者、营销人员和SEO团队了解其网站在Google搜索中的展示情况。

可用于：

• 通过检查索引状态、抓取和获取状态、机器人访问权限、站点地图、规范标签及移动可用性，诊断网站或URL未在Google展示的原因。

• 解释索引问题，例如「已抓取-当前未索引」、「已发现-当前未索引」、重复规范标签、noindex标记、被阻止页面、软404错误、重定向和服务器错误。

• 检查站点地图处理情况、错误警告、下载日期及URL数量。

• 通过查询、页面、国家、设备、日期或搜索展示位置，分析关键词和排名数据（包括点击量、展示量、点击率和平均排名）。

• 对比不同周期数据，发现流量增减情况、点击率优化机会、排名变化及驱动各页面流量的搜索关键词。

• 列出已连接的站点，并通过与ChatGPT和MCP的对话方式探索Search Console数据。

HYPD.AI 为只读模式，无法请求索引、提交站点地图、添加或验证站点、管理用户、编辑内容或更改排名。它会分析已连接的站点，解释分析结果并推荐下一步操作。

payload.name: Groas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Groas to explore your Google Ads accounts in ChatGPT. Review campaigns, keywords, search terms, daily performance, account audits, and the changes Groas has made. Ask questions about results and investigate opportunities to improve your campaigns. Account access follows your Groas login. Read access is the default; eligible subscribers can opt into permission to make changes. Authorized changes affect your connected Google Ads account and are recorded in Groas’s action history. A Groas account and connected Google Ads account are required for account analysis.
payload.longDescription: 将Groas连接至ChatGPT，以探索您的Google Ads账户。查看广告活动、关键词、搜索词、每日表现、账户审计及Groas所做的更改。针对结果提出问题并挖掘优化广告活动的机会。账户访问权限遵循您的Groas登录状态。默认为只读权限；符合条件的订阅者可选择开启修改权限。授权更改将影响您连接的Google Ads账户，并记录在Groas的操作历史中。进行账户分析需要Groas账户和已连接的Google Ads账户。

payload.name: Omneky
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omneky helps signed-in users review brand performance, manage product catalogue data, create image and product-video assets, and launch or manage campaigns across the signed-in brand's connected advertising channels. It does not manage calendars or banking, access another advertiser's accounts, or administer application deployments or DNS.
payload.longDescription: Omneky为已登录用户提供帮助，可审查品牌表现、管理产品目录数据、创建图像和产品视频资产，并在已登录品牌连接的广告渠道上启动或管理活动。该工具不管理日历或银行账户，不访问其他广告商的账户，也不负责应用程序部署或DNS管理。

payload.name: Trend Seeker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trend Seeker helps founders and researchers find business problems backed by public market signals. Search or browse ideas, inspect the reasoning behind one idea, compare a shortlist, and open dated source evidence. Trend Seeker scores help prioritize further research. They are not forecasts, financial advice, or guarantees of demand.
payload.longDescription: Trend Seeker 帮助创始人和研究人员找到由公开市场信号支持的商业问题。搜索或浏览创意，查看某个创意的推理依据，对比候选列表，并查看带有日期的原始证据。Trend Seeker 的评分有助于优先进行进一步研究。它们不是预测、财务建议或需求保证。

payload.name: AWS Data Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena. Covers managed Iceberg tables on S3 Tables, ingestion from JDBC databases, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, and DynamoDB, AWS Glue Data Catalog inventory and asset discovery, federated Athena queries, and vector storage and semantic search on Amazon S3 Vectors.
payload.longDescription: 使用 S3 Tables、AWS Glue 和 Athena 处理数据湖、分析和 ETL 工作流。涵盖 S3 Tables 上的托管 Iceberg 表，从 JDBC 数据库、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery 和 DynamoDB 摄取数据，AWS Glue Data Catalog 的目录清单及资产发现，Athena 联邦查询，以及 Amazon S3 Vectors 上的向量存储和语义搜索。

payload.name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
payload.description: 你的 AI 数据分析师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: From everyday data questions to high-level strategic analyses, Spotter by ThoughtSpot helps business and data teams get answers and insights they can trust, validate, and act on, enabling everyone to use data to drive the business forward.
payload.longDescription: 从日常数据问题到高层战略分析，ThoughtSpot 的 Spotter 都能帮助业务和数据团队获取可信、可验证且可采取行动的答案与洞察，让每个人都能利用数据推动业务发展。

payload.name: Sigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore, search, query your data, and build applications and dashboards in Sigma directly from the ChatGPT interface. You can search across your organization for relevant documents and elements, answer and iterate on complex data questions, and perform detailed analysis using natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 界面中探索、搜索和查询数据，并在 Sigma 中构建应用和控制面板。你可以在组织内搜索相关文档和元素，回答并迭代复杂的数据问题，也可以使用自然语言进行详细分析。

payload.name: Ingest Labs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ingest Labs connects ChatGPT to your production Ingest Labs account over MCP so you can query marketing analytics and inspect Tag Manager configuration.
Sign in with the same portal account used on console.ingestlabs.com.
After choosing an organization, use Insights tools for Attribution, Ad spend and ROAS, user events, Traffic Quality insights, and Tag Manager tools to list or change providers, tags, and data elements.

payload.name: GSC Wizard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
GSC Wizard将ChatGPT连接到您自己的Google搜索控制台属性，从而可以用自然语言分析SEO表现。
您可以请求性能摘要、顶级搜索词和页面、两个时间段之间的排名变化、内容衰减、关键词自相残杀、CTR与排名曲线或完整的SEO报告，并获得最终答案。
无需将数千行原始数据流式传输到模型中，每次分析都在数据仓库上进行服务器端计算，因此结果快速、准确且令牌高效。
您还可以列出并检查属性，运行Google的URL检查工具，跟踪索引情况，管理主题集群和内容组，并将URL提交到IndexNow。
它还会报告您自己的已链接Google Analytics 4属性：流量概览、维度分解、电子商务、关键事件（转化率）、由ChatGPT和Perplexity等AI助手带来的流量，以及混合的搜索控制台+GA4着陆页浏览量。
摘要工具可在ChatGPT中直接生成交互式卡片和表格。
所有访问权限均通过Google登录限定在您自己的账户中。

payload.name: Whatagraph
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect seamlessly to 60+ platforms—including Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, Meta, and more—and access all your cross-channel performance data in one place. Simply ask questions in natural language to retrieve campaign results, compare performance across channels, and uncover trends without digging through dashboards.

Explore your full reporting structure with ease: navigate spaces, reports, tabs, and widgets, and understand exactly how your data is organized. Dive into connected data sources to see available metrics and dimensions, so you can analyze performance with precision and confidence.

Whatagraph helps you go from raw data to clear insights—faster and smarter.
payload.longDescription:
无缝连接 60+ 个平台——包括 Google Ads、GA4、Shopify、Meta 等——并在一个地方查看跨渠道表现数据。只需用自然语言提问，即可检索营销活动结果、比较各渠道表现并发现趋势，无需翻查仪表板。

轻松查看完整的报告结构：浏览空间、报告、标签页和小组件，准确了解数据的组织方式。深入查看已连接的数据源，了解可用的指标和维度，从而精准、自信地分析表现。

Whatagraph 帮助你更快、更聪明地将原始数据转化为清晰洞察。

payload.name: PostHog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PostHog gives your AI agent direct access to your product analytics, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, surveys, logs, and LLM analytics. Ask questions about your data, create insights, toggle feature flags, analyze errors, search docs, and more — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: PostHog 让您的 AI 智能体直接访问产品分析、功能开关、实验、错误跟踪、调查、日志和 LLM 分析。您可以询问数据、创建分析洞察、切换功能开关、分析错误、搜索文档等，所有操作都可在聊天中完成。

payload.name: Helium 10
payload.description: 访问你的 Helium 10 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your Helium 10 data directly in ChatGPT for Amazon sellers and FBA brands. Query keyword and ASIN data, analyze PPC campaign performance and profitability, and extract insights from your listings and rank tracking.

Make Helium 10 a native part of your ChatGPT workflows without switching between dashboards or exporting files. Built for active e-commerce brands with real account data across Product Research, Ads, and Commerce.
payload.longDescription:
Amazon 卖家和 FBA 品牌可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问 Helium 10 数据。查询关键词和 ASIN 数据、分析 PPC 广告活动表现及盈利能力，并从商品列表和排名追踪中提取洞察。

无需在控制面板之间切换或导出文件，即可将 Helium 10 融入 ChatGPT 工作流程。专为拥有真实 Product Research、Ads 和 Commerce 账号数据的活跃电商品牌打造。

payload.name: Typeform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build forms, contact lists, and automations without leaving ChatGPT. Use natural language to analyze your form and survey data, create data-rich contact profiles, and build automations that turn your form respondents into customers. Typeform makes it easy to understand and act on your customer data—without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建表单、联系人列表和自动化流程。使用自然语言分析表单和问卷数据、创建包含丰富信息的联系人档案，并构建将表单答卷者转化为客户的自动化流程。Typeform 让你无需切换工具，即可轻松理解并使用客户数据。

payload.name: Amplitude
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplitude 工作区，搜索图表和控制面板，查询指标和实验结果，探索事件及属性，并创建或更新图表、控制面板和告警，无需离开对话。Amplitude 是团队用来了解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步构建什么的产品智能平台。

payload.name: Blockscout Blockchain Data
payload.description: 查找并分析区块链数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query live blockchain data across 90+ EVM-compatible blockchain networks directly in ChatGPT. Blockscout gives you instant access to wallet balances, transaction histories, token holdings, NFTs, smart contract source code, and contract ABIs, no API keys required.

Ask questions in plain English: "What tokens does this wallet hold?", "Show me recent transactions on this contract", or "Resolve this ENS name." Blockscout handles the lookup and returns structured, accurate on-chain data in seconds.
payload.longDescription:
直接在ChatGPT中查询90+个兼容EVM的区块链网络的实时数据。Blockscout让你即时获取钱包余额、交易历史、代币持仓、NFT、智能合约源代码和合约ABI，无需API密钥。

用日常英语提问：“这个钱包持有哪些代币？”“显示这个合约的近期交易”，或“解析这个ENS名称。”Blockscout负责查询，并在几秒内返回结构化、准确的链上数据。

payload.name: Mixpanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query and analyze your Mixpanel data directly in ChatGPT. Run segmentation, funnel, and retention analyses, explore your event taxonomy, manage Lexicon metadata, and resolve data quality issues - all without leaving your conversation.

With the Mixpanel MCP server connected, ChatGPT can reason about your product analytics alongside your code, documents, and decisions. Ask questions in plain language, drill into user behavior, and get answers grounded in your actual data.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中查询和分析你的 Mixpanel 数据。运行细分、漏斗和留存分析，探索事件分类，管理 Lexicon 元数据，并解决数据质量问题，全程无需离开对话。

连接 Mixpanel MCP 服务器后，ChatGPT 可以结合代码、文档和决策来推理产品分析。用自然语言提问、深入了解用户行为，并获得基于真实数据的答案。

payload.name: Waldo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Waldo helps users research brands, advertising, social conversations, trends, and captured workspace intelligence by combining specialized skills with external data and authenticated workspace context.
payload.longDescription: Waldo 结合专业技能、外部数据和经过身份验证的工作区上下文，帮助用户研究品牌、广告、社交讨论、趋势以及已捕获的工作区情报。

payload.name: Serpstat
payload.description: SEO 数据与关键词研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build semantic keyword clusters, discover untapped market niches from 1000+ categories, and conduct comprehensive competitor analysis. Examine rival SEO strategies through their keyword portfolios, backlink profiles, top-performing pages, and ranking dynamics. Track domain positions across regions, audit technical site issues, identify content gaps, and evaluate keyword opportunities with volume and difficulty metrics. Claude navigates these capabilities naturally — combining data from multiple sources, validating SEO hypotheses in real-time, and building comprehensive strategies through interactive dialogue.
payload.longDescription: 构建语义关键词集群，从 1000+ 个类别中发现尚未开发的细分市场，并全面分析竞争对手。通过竞争对手的关键词组合、反向链接资料、表现最佳页面和排名动态，研究其 SEO 策略。追踪各地区的域名搜索排名位置、审核网站技术问题、发现内容差距，并根据搜索量和难度指标评估关键词机会。Claude 可以自然地运用这些功能，将多个数据源结合起来、实时验证 SEO 假设，并通过互动对话制定全面策略。

payload.name: BlazeSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.

Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.

With context management, observability, and comprehensive access controls, BlazeSQL turns ChatGPT or Codex into an enterprise-ready AI Data Analyst for reliable self-service across your entire company.

As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.
payload.longDescription:
BlazeSQL 让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 查询你的数据库或数据仓库，并提供获得正确答案所需的全部上下文。

连接 Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift、Microsoft SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、AWS Athena、MariaDB、SQL Anywhere、Databricks、Clickhouse 和 Oracle。

借助上下文管理、可观测性和全面的访问控制，BlazeSQL 将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 转变为满足企业要求的 AI 数据分析师，在整个公司范围内提供可靠的自助服务。

作为全面的商业智能层，BlazeSQL 还支持可视化、控制面板、高级统计分析、预测分析、定期报告，以及自定义 PDF 或交互式 HTML 报告。

payload.name: Tableau (MCP only; EOL soon)
payload.description: Tableau（仅 MCP；即将结束生命周期）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This MCP based plugin will be deprecated shortly, please switch usage to the new Tableau Plugin.
payload.longDescription: 此基于 MCP 的插件即将停用，请改用新的 Tableau Plugin。

payload.name: Hex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answer data questions and spin up new analyses with the Hex Agent.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Hex Agent 解答数据问题，并开展新的分析。

payload.name: Trellis Law
payload.description: 美国州级初审法院研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Direct access to the US state trial court system, enabling legal research and insights on cases, verdicts, judges, attorneys, motions, litigation trends, and more - all grounded and sourced from trial court data and documents.
payload.longDescription: 直接访问美国州级初审法院系统，开展法律研究并获取有关案件、裁决、法官、律师、动议、诉讼趋势等方面的洞见；所有内容均以初审法院数据和文件为依据并附有来源。

payload.name: CData Connect AI
payload.description: 无需查询即可获得答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
payload.longDescription: Connect AI 可连接云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖仓、分析平台等，让您通过对话探索和分析数据。将数据用于 ChatGPT 中的工作，例如关联产品遥测与发布日程以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨来源构建具有明确关系和语义上下文的虚拟数据集，并将其呈现为专用工具，让 ChatGPT 按企业理解数据的方式工作，而不只是按数据存储方式工作。IT 管理员控制访问权限，并通过完整审计跟踪监控每次查询，确保合适的人访问合适的数据。

payload.name: MotherDuck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 助手连接到 MotherDuck 数据仓库。使用自然语言浏览、可视化和管理数据，无需 SQL 技能。创建 Dives：可交互的可视化内容，让你保存并与团队共享答案，同时保持最新数据同步。无需语义模型或预配置，即可处理真实世界的数据。你的 AI 助手会像数据分析师一样迭代探索、验证、分析和可视化数据，从而回答问题。

payload.name: StatsHawk
payload.description: 体育数据、球员道具投注与对阵分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minutes of box scores posting.

Beyond the basics: MLB pitch-by-pitch with Statcast detail (pitch type, velocity, launch data, filterable to a batter-pitcher matchup) and pre-computed player prop analysis, season, recent, and home/away averages with hit rates against any line, built for fantasy research, start/sit calls, and matchup prep.

Sign in with a free StatsHawk account when you connect; no API key to manage. Free includes 5,000 usage credits monthly and every standard stat tool. Prop analysis comes with paid plans.
payload.longDescription:
StatsHawk 为 ChatGPT 提供真实、最新的体育数据，而不是训练数据中的猜测。你可以询问任意比赛，并获取比分、赛程、排名、比赛数据表、球队名单和球员查询，覆盖 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA 篮球和橄榄球，以及包括 Premier League 在内的主要足球赛事。所有数据都经过统一规范，更新时间距离比赛数据表发布仅几分钟。

除基础功能外，还包括 MLB 逐球数据及 Statcast 详情（球种、球速、击球初速和角度数据，可按击球手与投手对阵筛选），以及预先计算的球员道具投注分析、赛季/近期/主客场平均值和针对任意盘口的命中率，适合幻想体育研究、先发/替补选择和对阵准备。

连接时使用免费的 StatsHawk 账户登录；无需管理 API 密钥。免费账户每月包含 5,000 个使用积分和所有标准统计工具。球员道具分析需使用付费套餐。

payload.name: GIS Cloud
payload.description: 创建地图并进行 GIS 分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries. 

This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and organize maps and layers
- Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
- Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
- Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
- Import files and manage datasets
- Generate reports from your geospatial data

You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.
payload.longDescription:
GIS Cloud 是一款云端地理空间平台，供 60 多个国家的政府、公用事业单位和外勤团队使用。

此应用让你可以用日常语言操作自己的 GIS Cloud 账户，无需 GIS 专业知识，也不必在菜单中反复点击。

让 ChatGPT 创建和编辑地图、创建并设置图层样式、添加或查询要素、运行空间分析、为外勤团队设计移动数据采集表单、导入数据集并生成报告。它覆盖完整 GIS 工作流程，从外勤采集到制图、分析和报告。

你可以：
- 创建、更新和整理地图及图层
- 添加、编辑和查询要素及属性数据
- 对数据运行空间分析并计算统计数据
- 为外勤团队创建和管理移动数据采集表单
- 导入文件并管理数据集
- 根据地理空间数据生成报告

由你掌控操作。GIS Cloud 采用“提出并确认”模式：在写入账户前会先提出变更，并明确标记具有破坏性的操作。访问权限通过安全的 OAuth 限定在你的账户范围内，只读操作与写入操作相互区分。

可与现有 GIS Cloud 账户配合使用。还没有 GIS Cloud 账户？可在 giscloud.com 免费注册。

payload.name: Powerset Research
payload.description: 访问 Powerset Research 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Powerset Research (https://research.powerset.co/) is a technical journal from Powerset (https://powerset.co/) where we analyze tech trends, publish analytics, and provide free tools for helping founders. This app allows anyone to access the data underlying Powerset Research via ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Powerset Research（https://research.powerset.co/）是 Powerset（https://powerset.co/）的技术期刊，分析科技趋势、发布分析报告，并提供帮助创业者的免费工具。此应用让任何人都能通过 ChatGPT 访问 Powerset Research 的底层数据。

payload.name: Similarweb
payload.description: 网站、应用、搜索和市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research any website or app inside ChatGPT using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts. E-commerce, email, and app research: Explore Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp data. Research apps, developers, and reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play.

电商、邮件与应用研究：探索Shopify、WooCommerce、Magento、Google商家中心、Klaviyo和Mailchimp数据。

payload.name: Adobe CJA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics helps authorized users discover data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges, projects, and audiences; run ranked CJA reports; inspect component definitions; and create or update reusable CJA components and Workspace projects through ChatGPT. payload.longDescription: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics 帮助获授权的用户通过 ChatGPT 查找数据视图、维度、指标、细分群体、日期范围、项目和受众；运行排名式CJA报告；检查组件定义；以及创建或更新可复用的CJA组件和 Workspace 项目。它需要 Adobe IMS OAuth 及 Customer Journey Analytics 产品访问权限，工具调用会使用已登录用户的IMS组织、沙盒或产品上下文，以及CJA权限。

payload.name: Catchr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Catchr helps marketers and agencies work with their marketing data directly in ChatGPT. 
Ask questions about campaign performance, compare results across connected sources, and turn raw metrics into clear reporting insights for clients and teams.
payload.longDescription: Catchr 帮助营销人员和代理机构直接在 ChatGPT 中处理营销数据。询问营销活动表现、比较已连接来源的结果，并将原始指标转化为面向客户和团队的清晰报告洞察。

payload.name: Lytical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lytical automatically captures website activity and turns it into useful insights so you can understand traffic, behavior, and trends without digging through analytics reports. It helps you quickly answer questions like what changed, why it changed, and what to do next.
payload.longDescription: Lytical 会自动采集网站活动并将其转化为实用洞察，帮助你了解流量、用户行为和趋势，无需费力翻查分析报告。它能帮你快速回答诸如发生了什么变化、变化原因以及接下来该做什么等问题。

payload.name: Syncly Social
payload.description: 追踪社交媒体上的品牌提及
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Syncly's social intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. Search brand mentions across social, including video. Track sentiment and mention volume over time, surface top creators, keywords, and trends, and rank posts by performance to see what is working.
payload.longDescription: 将 Syncly 的社交媒体洞察引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。搜索社交平台上的品牌提及，包括视频内容。追踪情绪倾向和提及量的变化，发现热门创作者、关键词和趋势，并按表现为帖子排名，以了解哪些内容有效。

payload.name: Landstack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Landstack MCP connects your AI model directly to UK land, planning and development data. Search and analyse planning applications, read planning documents, review local and neighbourhood plans, explore site allocations and land availability assessments, and look up title ownership data — all without leaving your AI workflow. 

Whether you're evaluating a single site or working through hundreds, Landstack gives your model the context it needs to answer detailed questions about planning history, policy constraints and land ownership across England, Wales and Scotland.
payload.longDescription:
Landstack MCP 可将 AI 模型直接连接到英国土地、规划和开发数据。搜索规划申请、阅读规划文件、审阅地方及社区规划、查看地块分配和土地可用性评估，并查询产权所有权数据——全程无需离开 AI 工作流。

无论是评估单个地块，还是处理数百个地块，Landstack 都能为模型提供所需背景信息，以便回答有关英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰规划历史、政策限制及土地所有权的详细问题。

payload.name: Property Hazard MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hazard lookup for any US address — flood, wildfire, earthquake, and coastal-storm exposure in a single call, using public government data (Census, FEMA, USGS). No API key required.
payload.longDescription: 只需一次调用，即可查询美国任意地址面临的危险——包括洪水、野火、地震和沿海风暴暴露风险；数据来自 Census、FEMA 和 USGS 等政府公开数据源。无需 API 密钥。

payload.name: Kindora
payload.description: 社会公益领域资助方研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kindora gives nonprofits and researchers direct access to the philanthropic funding landscape. Search grantmakers by name, cause area, geography, size, or classification; review IRS 990 financial summaries and grant histories; find open foundation and government grant opportunities; analyze giving patterns; and browse philanthropy jobs. Results come from public filings, public funder websites, and Kindora's curated funder corpus. The submitted tools are free, read-only, and require no Kindora account.
payload.longDescription: Kindora 为非营利组织和研究人员直接提供慈善资助领域信息。按名称、事业领域、地理位置、规模或分类搜索资助机构；查看 IRS 990 财务摘要和资助历史；查找开放申请的基金会和政府资助机会；分析捐赠模式；并浏览慈善领域职位。结果来自公开申报资料、资助方官网和 Kindora 精选的资助方语料库。提交的工具免费、只读，无需 Kindora 账户。

payload.name: Improvado AI Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Improvado AI Agent helps users work with Improvado workspaces through ChatGPT: inspect workspaces, data sources, connections, extracts, loads, documents, dashboards, recipes, and Discovery API workflows; switch workspace context; query data; and create or update private workspace resources.
payload.longDescription: Improvado AI Agent 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 Improvado 工作区：检查工作区、数据源、连接、提取、加载、文档、仪表板、配方和 Discovery API 工作流；切换工作区上下文；查询数据；以及创建或更新工作区私有资源。

payload.name: Reverse Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reverse Contact turns an email address, a name, or a LinkedIn URL into a professional profile. Ask who is behind an email address, summarise a person and the company they work for, or search people and companies by job title, industry, headcount and location.

Cached lookups return instantly. Live tools start a fresh collection and run asynchronously, returning a task you poll until it completes. Every call costs credits from your Reverse Contact workspace, and checking your balance is free.

You need a Reverse Contact account to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
Reverse Contact 可将电子邮件地址、姓名或 LinkedIn URL 转换为职业档案。你可以询问某个电子邮件地址背后的人是谁、总结某个人及其任职公司，或按职位名称、行业、员工人数和地点搜索个人及公司。

缓存查询会即时返回结果。实时工具会启动新的数据收集并异步运行，返回一个任务供你轮询，直到任务完成。每次调用都会消耗 Reverse Contact 工作区的额度，查询余额免费。

使用此插件需要 Reverse Contact 账户。

payload.name: Fr8Labs Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask your freight-forwarding data anything — shipments, revenue, costs, margins, P&L, and AR/AP ageing — in plain language, and turn answers into charts, dashboards, and scheduled email reports, straight from your Fr8Labs FMS. Every query is scoped to your own company's data: results are read from a tenant-isolated analytics warehouse, and reports email only to your own domain. Built for freight-forwarding operators and finance teams who want self-service analytics without writing SQL.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言查询 Fr8Labs 货运转发数据，包括货运、收入、成本、利润、损益和应收应付账龄，并生成图表、仪表板和定时邮件报告。查询仅限公司隔离数据，邮件仅发到本公司域名。

payload.name: Master Metrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Master Metrics connects marketing teams to more than 25+ data sources in one place. Pull performance data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics, Shopify, WooCommerce, Tiendanube, Kommo and more than 25 data sources— without switching between platforms.

Designed for marketing teams managing multiple clients, Master Metrics is the most accessible and straightforward alternative for teams in Latin America and beyond. A free registered account is required. Sign up at mastermetrics.com
payload.longDescription:
Master Metrics 将 25 多个数据源连接到一处，服务营销团队。无需在平台之间切换，即可从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、TikTok Ads、Google Analytics、Shopify、WooCommerce、Tiendanube、Kommo 以及 25 多个数据源提取表现数据。

Master Metrics 专为管理多个客户的营销团队设计，是拉丁美洲及其他地区团队最易用、最直接的替代方案。需要免费注册账户。请在 mastermetrics.com 注册。

payload.name: PolicyNote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use the PolicyNote app to access structured policy and regulatory intelligence from around the world. Search legislation, regulatory actions, policy updates, and government activity across jurisdictions.

The app enables developers, analysts, and policy professionals to retrieve policy data programmatically and integrate it into internal tools, research workflows, dashboards, or monitoring systems. Queries return structured information about policy developments, government sources, and regulatory changes.

PolicyNote helps teams track public policy activity, build alerts, power analysis tools, and integrate government intelligence into their applications.
payload.longDescription:
使用 PolicyNote 应用访问来自世界各地的结构化政策和监管情报。搜索不同司法管辖区的法律、监管行动、政策更新和政府活动。

此应用使开发者、分析师和政策专业人士能够通过程序检索政策数据，并将其集成到内部工具、研究工作流、仪表板或监测系统中。查询会返回关于政策动态、政府来源和监管变更的结构化信息。

PolicyNote 帮助团队追踪公共政策动态、创建提醒、构建分析工具，并将政府情报集成到自己的应用程序中。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Monitor and analyze your brand's visibility across AI search engines. Track your visibility, sentiment, and share of voice and compare to competitors.
payload.longDescription: 监测并分析您的品牌在 AI 搜索引擎中的可见度。追踪可见度、情感倾向和声量份额，并与竞争对手比较。

payload.name: Realpage Lumina
payload.description: 查询你的 Realpage 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lumina Model Connect turns ChatGPT into a direct line to your Realpage data. Governed, curated, and built for answers you can trust. Ask questions in plain language, generate reports on the fly, and skip the queue for your data team - get answers now. Realpage subscription(s) required.
payload.longDescription: Lumina Model Connect 让 ChatGPT 可以直接访问你的 Realpage 数据。数据经过治理和筛选，旨在提供可信答案。用日常语言提问，即时生成报告，无需排队等待数据团队处理，立即获取答案。需要 Realpage 订阅。

payload.name: Yuno
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask questions about your Yuno payment data in plain language. Yuno connects your assistant to your organization's analytics so you can check transactions, approval and conversion rates, and provider performance.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言提问关于您的 Yuno 支付数据的问题。Yuno 将您的助手与组织的分析工具连接，以便查看交易记录、审批与转化率以及供应商表现。

payload.name: ApartmentIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ApartmentIQ is multifamily’s all-in-one, daily data platform covering 40M units. It integrates daily property and market signals into modern tools for market surveys, investment research, and revenue management. Owners, operators, and investors use ApartmentIQ to benchmark performance, price confidently, and move faster – trusted by 70% of the NMHC Top 50.
payload.longDescription: ApartmentIQ 是多户住宅行业的一体化每日数据平台，覆盖 40M 套住宅。它将每日房产和市场信号整合进现代工具，用于市场调查、投资研究和收入管理。业主、运营方和投资者利用 ApartmentIQ 比较表现、自信定价并加快行动——NMHC Top 50 中 70% 的企业信赖它。

payload.name: Clics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your website traffic, conversions, and visitor behavior with simple, cookieless, privacy-first analytics - directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用简单、无 Cookie、优先保护隐私的分析功能，分析网站流量、转化和访客行为。

payload.name: KrystalView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KrystalView helps users inspect real website behavior from ChatGPT. It can list recent visitor sessions, drill into session detail, summarize site stats, analyze scroll depth, show live visitors, explain anomalies, inspect funnels, report campaign attribution and ROAS, list browser errors, and retrieve recent analytics notifications.
payload.longDescription: KrystalView 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中查看真实的网站行为。它可以列出近期访客会话、深入查看会话详情、汇总网站统计数据、分析滚动深度、显示实时访客、解释异常、检查转化漏斗、报告营销活动归因和 ROAS、列出浏览器错误，以及检索近期分析通知。

payload.name: Evidence Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets ChatGPT work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

After you connect your Evidence account, ChatGPT can:
- Browse table metadata
- Run read-only queries against data stored in Evidence
- Search your published reports by topic, metric, or term, and read a page's content or a structured summary of its queries and components
- Retrieve AI context stored in Evidence - so answers match how your organization reports
payload.longDescription:
Evidence 是一款使用 SQL 和 Markdown 发布报告的 AI 驱动型 BI 工具。此连接器可代表你安全地访问组织的实时数据和已发布报告，并遵循你的个人权限。

连接 Evidence 账户后，ChatGPT 可以：
- 浏览表元数据
- 对存储在 Evidence 中的数据运行只读查询
- 按主题、指标或词语搜索已发布报告，并读取页面内容或其中查询和组件的结构化摘要
- 检索存储在 Evidence 中的 AI 上下文，让回答符合组织的报告口径

payload.name: Temso
payload.description: 追踪品牌在 AI 对话中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI chats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Temso tracks your brand's visibility across AI assistants — share of voice, sentiment, which sources they cite, and recommended actions to improve. Connect Temso to ask about your AI-visibility data in natural language and pull live analytics straight into the chat.
payload.longDescription: Temso 可追踪你的品牌在各 AI 助手中的曝光度，包括声量份额、情绪倾向、引用来源以及改进建议。连接 Temso 后，即可用自然语言询问 AI 曝光数据，并将实时分析直接带入聊天。

payload.name: Windsock
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.
payload.longDescription:
Windsock 估算通用航空飞机的市场价值，并提供支持该估值的市场数据。输入飞机的尾号（N-number），即可获得当前估算市场价值、可比飞机以及该品牌和型号近期价格趋势。
你可以用日常语言提出后续问题，例如航电设备、大修后的发动机使用时间、损伤记录或所在地如何影响价值；类似飞机通常需要多久售出；以及整个细分市场的走势。Windsock 还会调取 FAA 注册信息、适航指令和机场级信息，包括当前天气及燃油价格预测。
它面向飞机所有者、买家、卖家、经纪人，以及任何需要可靠了解飞机价值及市场走势的人。估值由模型生成，仅供参考，并非经过认证的评估。

payload.name: DMAP AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DMAP AI helps users analyze drought conditions for a selected location and time period. It returns SPI tables, drought severity events, wavelet scalogram summaries, and drought periodicity diagnostics using NASA POWER or ERA5 data. Copula and paid workflows are not included in this ChatGPT version.
payload.longDescription: DMAP AI 可帮助用户分析所选地点和时间段的干旱状况。它使用 NASA POWER 或 ERA5 数据，返回 SPI 表格、干旱严重程度事件、小波标度图摘要和干旱周期诊断。本 ChatGPT 版本不包含 Copula 和付费工作流。

payload.name: DC PASS Contracts
payload.description: 搜索华盛顿特区政府合同
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This app allows searching the 50,000 contracts awarded by the District of Columbia government since 2015.
payload.longDescription: 此应用可搜索自 2015 年以来由哥伦比亚特区政府授予的 50,000 份合同。

payload.name: Trace
payload.description: AI 原生企业技术画像
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trace gives agents structured data on what technologies companies use, who they partner with, and who they're hiring. Ask about any company's tech stack, integration ecosystem, or recent hiring signals, and Trace returns structured answers. Create lists to monitor changes over time. Useful for account research, market analysis, competitive insights, or spotting when a company adopts a new tool or partner.
payload.longDescription: Trace 为智能体提供结构化数据，说明企业使用哪些技术、与谁合作，以及正在招聘哪些人员。询问任意企业的技术栈、集成生态或近期招聘信号，Trace 就会返回结构化答案。创建列表以持续监测变化。适用于客户研究、市场分析、竞争洞察，或发现企业何时采用新工具或建立新合作关系。

payload.name: Amplifyr
payload.description: 品牌 AI 可见度智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Amplifyr gives ChatGPT direct access to your brand's AI visibility analytics.
